checks.sample_quotes: All 16 non-null quotes appear verbatim. Each sample misses exactly one content goal and retains one comprehensible learner grammar error.
checks.starters: All 22 partial frames allow grammatical, criterion-aligned completion; two afspraak frames simplified. No supplied completions or invented facts occur in the starter overlay.

diversity: Appointment change, lost card, ladder loan, course information, found key and shoe exchange retain the six historical subjects. Four emails differ in purpose and register; two forms collect distinct practical information. Three neighbourhood settings are inherited replacements. This batch is not a complete exam form.
author_doubts_decisions: The found-key form is a coherent way for a building manager to collect the preserved neighbour notice. The supplied contact field supports the model reply route.
Form personal details are completed in their own short fields; samples and models illustrate only the three open answers.
The initial afspraak availability quote lacked a usable time reference. The repaired sample gives a proposed time and omits the reason instead.
No organisation-name checks were required because the draft contains only generic institutions and reserved scaffold addresses.
limitations: AI editorial review only; A2 remains an unvalidated authoring target.
No calibrated exemplar directory exists; batch008 items are project references and the official-format comparison uses the supplied internal research.
